# Cashu Card

> Cashu Card is an open NFC ecash protocol. Its core is NUT-CCP, a draft Cashu NUT. Wallets load Cashu ecash onto an NFC smart card, and a till can accept a tap offline and settle with the mint when it is connected. The applet runs on NXP J3R180 cards (Java Card 3.0.5).

## Guides

- [Install the Cashu Card applet, for AI agents](https://cashucard.org/guide.md): installs the applet on a blank J3R180 card from a computer with a card reader, with every command, its expected answer and the points where the agent stops and asks its person.
- [Install guide](https://cashucard.org/guide): the same steps as a page for people.
- [Cashu Card Provisioner](https://cashucard.org/#install): an app for card issuers that installs the applet on blank cards over a phone's NFC, in beta on [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/M3JucFNy) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.islandbitcoin.provisioner).

## Protocol and code

- [Draft specification](https://github.com/cashucard/nut/blob/main/CCP.md): NUT-CCP, the core every card and reader share: selecting the card, card proofs, reading, paying, the card's change and loading.
- [Test vectors](https://github.com/cashucard/nut/blob/main/tests/CCP-tests.md): NUT-CCP's card proof secrets, payments with and without change, and AUTH, worked through.
- [APDU reference](https://github.com/cashucard/cashucard/blob/main/spec/APDU.md): the card's wire, byte for byte, with the profiles for the owner, the clock and the limits, and the NFC tag.
- [Source](https://github.com/cashucard/cashucard): the applet, its host tools and simulator, and the provisioning app.
